description: This file must be renovate.json in the repository root (not .github/renovate.json5): HomeAtlas is a fork, and for forks Renovate checks forkProcessing in renovate.json only, before it reads any other config file.

packageRules.description: Backend: ruff + ~260 pytest tests, API routes exercised through FastAPI's TestClient (fastapi, starlette, pydantic, httpx). Enough to merge minor updates unattended.
Frontend: tsc + vite build, plus a browser smoke test of the built images (build.yml, job smoke: login -> MFA -> setup -> app routes incl. Markdown). Enough to merge minor updates unattended.
